The '''Balosar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. The system contained the ecologically-damaged and poverty-stricken [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Balosar/Legends|Balosar]].

==History==
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], the Balosar system was the theater of a [[Battle of the Balosar system|battle]] concluded with a Republic victory.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=space|Balosar Outpost}}</ref>
